text_en: Thus says the Lord : Where is your mother’s bill of divorce with which I put her away? Or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? No, because of your sins you were sold, and for your transgressions your mother was put away.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“我离弃你们母亲的离婚书在那里呢？或者我把你们卖给了我的那一位债主呢？看！因了你们的恶行，你们才被出卖，因了你们的过犯，你们的母亲才被离弃。

text_en: Why was no one there when I came? Why did no one answer when I called? Is my hand shortened, that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? By my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a desert; their fish stink for lack of water, and die of thirst.
text_cn: 为什么我来到的时候，没有人在呢？为什么我召呼的时候，无人答应？难道我的手短小而不能施救？或者我再无救助之力？看！我一怒喝，海便涸(hé)竭(jié)，江河便成为旷野，其中的鱼类因无水而萎缩渴死。

text_en: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and make sackcloth their covering.
text_cn: 我可使黑暗笼罩诸天，使麻衣掩蔽天际。”

text_en: The Lord God has given me the tongue of a teacher, that I may know how to sustain the weary with a word. Morning by morning he wakens— wakens my ear to listen as those who are taught.
text_cn: 吾主上主赐给了我一个受教的口舌，叫我会用言语援助疲倦的人。他每天清晨唤醒我，唤醒我的耳朵，叫我如同学子一样静听。

text_en: The Lord God has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious, I did not turn backward.
text_cn: 吾主上主开启了我的耳朵，我并没有违抗，也没有退避。

text_en: I gave my back to those who struck me, and my cheeks to those who pulled out the beard; I did not hide my face from insult and spitting.
text_cn: 我将我的背转给打击我的人，把我的腮转给扯我胡须的人；对于侮辱和唾污，我没有遮掩我的面。

text_en: The Lord God helps me; therefore I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set my face like flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame;
text_cn: 因为吾主上主协助我，因此我不以为羞耻；所以我板着脸，像一块燧石，因我知道我不会受耻辱。

text_en: he who vindicates me is near. Who will contend with me? Let us stand up together. Who are my adversaries? Let them confront me.
text_cn: 那给我伸冤者已来近了。谁要和我争辩，让我们一齐站起来吧！谁是我的对头，叫他到我这里来吧！

text_en: It is the Lord God who helps me; who will declare me guilty? All of them will wear out like a garment; the moth will eat them up.
text_cn: 请看！有吾主上主扶助我，谁还能定我的罪呢？看！他们都像衣服一样要破旧，为蠹（dù）虫所侵蚀。

text_en: Who among you fears the Lord and obeys the voice of his servant, who walks in darkness and has no light, yet trusts in the name of the Lord and relies upon his God?
text_cn: 你们中凡敬畏上主的，应听他仆人的声音！凡于黑暗中行走而不见光明的，该依靠上主的名字，并仰仗自己的天主。

text_en: But all of you are kindlers of fire, lighters of firebrands. Walk in the flame of your fire, and among the brands that you have kindled! This is what you shall have from my hand: you shall lie down in torment.
text_cn: 看哪！凡你们点了火，燃了火把的，必要在你们所点的火焰里，在你们所燃的火把中行走！这是我的手所加于你们的，你们必倒卧在痛苦之中。
